name: El Quintos
description: El Quintos was a street gang based in the East Williamsburg area of Brooklyn, active from at least the early 1950s through at least 1961. The gang was involved in several documented violent incidents: in January 1953, member Eleazar Collins was killed by the rival Bedford-Stuyvesant gang El Mambo Reys; in October 1954, member Raymond 'Dewdrop' Holley shot and killed rival Jesse Lipscombe with a shotgun and was sentenced to 30 years, with accomplices Robert Smith and Robert Williams also imprisoned; and in October 1961, member Louis Ressey beat Black Diamonds member Solomon Valle to death with a stick. Police initially believed Fred Bronson was a member of El Quintos, though this was later disputed by a former member of the gang.
